ideas.name: with VWAP: long above, short below
ideas.why: a breakout on the side of the day's average price has the session's buyers (sellers) in profit behind it; across VWAP it runs into the other side's average

ideas.name: VWAP's 15-minute slope agrees
ideas.why: the volume-weighted flow already leans the breakout's way; against it, the break is into flow

ideas.name: not stretched: within 2 five-minute ATRs of VWAP
ideas.why: far from VWAP the breakout is late; mean-reverting liquidity providers lean against it

ideas.name: the day has used under 75% of its average range
ideas.why: room to run: a breakout late in a full day has the day's range against it (the book halves size at 0.9)

ideas.name: beyond the prior day's high (long) / low (short)
ideas.why: a break of yesterday's extreme triggers the stops and breakout orders resting there: forced flow its way

ideas.name: not at lunch (11:30-13:00 CT)
ideas.why: lunch is thin; breakouts then lack the participation to follow through

ideas.name: the fast row (3/13) not warning against it
ideas.why: confirmed #3: a fast-row warning calls a turn; a breakout into one starts as the move fades

ideas.name: volume above the last 10 sessions' at this minute
ideas.why: a breakout on heavy participation is real buying (selling); on light volume it is a few orders

ideas.name: VXN above its 60-session median
ideas.why: in volatile markets dealers are shorter gamma and hedge with the move, so breakouts extend
